public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let all_steps be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  let mutable remaining be dependencies
  let mutable ordered be []

  for each step in all_steps
    for each depends_on in dependencies.get(step) otherwise []
      if not dependencies.contains_key(depends_on) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: depends_on)
      end
    end
  end

  repeat until remaining.is_empty()
    let ready be
      for each step in remaining.keys().sorted()
      where remaining.get(step) otherwise [] all remaining.get(step) otherwise [].contains(step) is false
      collect step

    if ready.is_empty() then
      fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining.keys().sorted())
    end

    let next_step be ready.first() otherwise crash with "unreachable: no ready step"
    set ordered to ordered.append(next_step)
    set remaining to remaining.without(next_step)
  end

  return ordered
end

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let all_steps be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  let mutable remaining be dependencies
  let mutable ordered be []
  let mutable ready be []

  for each step in all_steps
    let deps be dependencies.get(step) otherwise fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: step)
    if deps.all(dep is dependencies.contains_key(dep)) then
      if deps.length() is 0 then
        set ready to ready.append(step)
      end
    end
  end

  repeat until ready.length() is 0
    let step be ready.first() otherwise crash with "unreachable: ready is empty"
    set ready to ready.without_index(0)
    set ordered to ordered.append(step)
    set remaining to remaining.without(step)

    let mutable newly_ready be []

    for each candidate in remaining.keys().sorted()
      let deps be remaining.get(candidate) otherwise fail with UnknownDependency(step: candidate, depends_on: candidate)
      if deps.all(dep is ordered.contains(dep) or not remaining.contains_key(dep)) then
        if not ordered.contains(candidate) and not ready.contains(candidate) and not newly_ready.contains(candidate) then
          set newly_ready to newly_ready.append(candidate)
        end
      end
    end

    set ready to ready.append_all(newly_ready).sorted()
  end

  if remaining.length() is 0 then
    return ordered
  otherwise
    let mutable cycle_steps be []
    for each step in remaining.keys().sorted()
      set cycle_steps to cycle_steps.append(step)
    end
    fail with Cycle(remaining: cycle_steps)
  end
end
